definitions.explanation: A decrease in a rate, price, level, or standard. Commonly used for prices, taxes, interest rates, and age limits.

examples.japanese: ⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{引|ひ}き{下|さ}げ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}した→発表する：25231_happyousuru⟧。
⟦{金利|きんり}→金利：04856_kinri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{引|ひ}き{下|さ}げ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{景気|けいき}→景気：02694_keiki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{刺激|しげき}する→刺激する：20205_shigekisuru⟧。
examples.english: An interest rate cut stimulates the economy.

examples.japanese: ⟦{成人|せいじん}→成人：03378_seijin⟧⟦{年齢|ねんれい}→年齢：01490_nenrei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{引|ひ}き{下|さ}げ⟦について→〜について：03103_nitsuite⟧⟦{国会|こっかい}→国会：02761_kokkai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{議論|ぎろん}→議論：02650_giron⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The lowering of the age of adulthood is being debated in the National Diet.

notes:
USAGE:
The opposite of ⟦{引|ひ}き{上|あ}げ→引き上げ：12552_hikiage⟧ (increase, raise). Used extensively in economic, political, and administrative contexts when discussing reductions in numerical values such as prices, taxes, rates, or age thresholds.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{引|ひ}き{下|さ}げ: price reduction
- ⟦{金利|きんり}→金利：04856_kinri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{引|ひ}き{下|さ}げ: interest rate cut
- ⟦{税率|ぜいりつ}→税率：28616_zeiritsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{引|ひ}き{下|さ}げ: tax rate reduction
- ⟦{年齢|ねんれい}→年齢：01490_nenrei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{引|ひ}き{下|さ}げ: lowering of the age (limit)
